F1 link-flag GHZ frame (flip qubit F = g_b): link prep with g copies in R2, U_E as 4 phases on L2, per-corner CX+CCX (CZ.CX merged, CS^dag + rccx), r folded into the R2 slots, sector height h_b by a flip-invariant 3-way rccx mux whose selectors also give K1=[r=101] and z=[r=000], tau removed by plain CX(h_X->e1) before a relative-phase 2-control H, closed-pair GHZ gadget; bright flag = NOR of 4 rccx-folded e1 plus z & e2=1111 for the closed pair; one 8-term Gray-cycle uniformly controlled Rz on F (8 CX); all angles linear in alpha, beta, sqrt2 beta.

F2 explicit direction qubit: link prep, g-controlled canonicaliser + Bell map at corners c0/c2, direction f = [x0=g_b][x10=g_t] in one Toffoli, f-controlled lowering at c1/c3, c0/c2 partner fix, then a 6-term Walsh multiplexer on f over four good-equal-corner bits plus kappa=1 and closed-pair gadgets; all angles are integer (closed: sqrt2) multiples of beta.

exact degree-1 spectral transform of a flat dilation of W = prod_c K_c (F4): corner-local Dicke frame (pseudo-spin chain e1 -> S -> e3 made classical, U_E as 4 free phases), direction qubit q = f(data), q-controlled corner-local lowering J so both members of every bright pair share the data register, then one class-multiplexed Rx on q gated by AND_c[corner is a raising source and not dark]; closed chain via q=|+> on the all-Q loop plus an A<->L toggle.

frame D (link prep, corner CX/CCX/C2H, GHZ fold of the Q flags; U_E = 4 phases on the flags) sends 80 bright pairs to basis pairs; per r-class (7) merged Toffolis make partners differ only in F=q1, a 4-7 literal rccx AND (shared invariant prefixes) flags the class and one crx(-2 kappa s beta) rotates it; closed pair by an unconditional CX.CH.H basis change and one crx; then D^dagger.
